description: This file defines a PHP trait 'SectionListTrait' for managing a list of layout sections within Drupal's layout builder module. It includes methods for adding, removing, inserting, and cloning sections, as well as handling blank sections.

classes.name: SectionListTrait
classes.description: A trait providing methods to manage a list of layout sections, including adding, removing, inserting, and cloning sections, with support for blank sections.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of sections, considering blank sections.

methods.name: getSection
methods.description: Retrieves a section by its delta index.

methods.name: setSection
methods.description: Sets a section at a specific delta index.

methods.name: appendSection
methods.description: Appends a new section to the list.

methods.name: insertSection
methods.description: Inserts a section at a specific delta, handling blank sections.

methods.name: addBlankSection
methods.description: Adds a blank section to the list, ensuring only one exists at delta 0.

methods.name: hasBlankSection
methods.description: Checks if the list contains a blank section.

methods.name: removeSection
methods.description: Removes a section at a specified delta, managing blank sections.

methods.name: removeAllSections
methods.description: Removes all sections, optionally adding a blank section.

methods.name: hasSection
methods.description: Checks if a section exists at a given delta.

methods.name: __clone
methods.description: Performs a deep clone of the section list.
